title: Ghislaine Maxwell's TerraMar Project as an elite offshore trading network
place_text: oceans, near Antarctica; Richard Branson's island

tellings.quote: it's like this elite network of trading routes trading routes and shipping containers going around places like near Antarctica off the grid and it was being held by all these [ __ ] huge elites.

plain: The TerraMar Project, an ocean group run by Ghislaine Maxwell, a long-time associate of the financier Jeffrey Epstein, was really an elite network of trading routes and shipping containers moving off the grid, to places like the waters near Antarctica, according to the researcher Jay Anderson. He says it was run by huge elites and ties it to the British businessman Richard Branson's island, passing this on from others. If true, the project would have been a hidden private network for the very rich.
